guides.title: Demo-campus Wi-Fi credential error on macOS

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
sections.text: Demo-campus Wi-Fi stopped working on macOS. A demo credential error prevents this laptop from connecting to the wireless campus network. Try reconnecting in the fictional training environment.
steps: Open the Wi-Fi settings on your macOS device.
Select the fictional demo-campus network and disconnect once.
Reconnect to demo-campus using the demonstration account in your training environment. Never share its password here.

guides.title: Demo-campus Wi-Fi on macOS: connection check

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
sections.text: An alternative for demo-campus Wi-Fi stopped working on macOS with a demo credential error after reconnecting did not fix it. Check the wireless connection before asking a technician.
steps: Open Wi-Fi settings on macOS and confirm Wi-Fi is enabled.
Toggle Wi-Fi off and back on once.
Select demo-campus again. Record the exact error if the connection still fails.

guides.title: Demo-guest Wi-Fi connection on macOS

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
sections.text: Demo-guest guest wireless Wi-Fi connection on macOS fails to open the training portal.
steps: Open Wi-Fi settings on macOS.
Select the fictional demo-guest network.
Open the training portal page supplied by your instructor. Stop if it asks for personal information.

guides.title: Demo-Lab printer queue on macOS

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
sections.text: The Demo-Lab printer on macOS has a stuck print queue and is not printing a demonstration document.
steps: Open the printer queue on macOS.
Select Demo-Lab in the training printer list.
Cancel your own stuck demo job and try one test page.

guides.title: Demo-account forgotten password

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
sections.text: Forgotten password for Demo-Account account login: cannot sign in and needs a password reset in the fictional training environment.
steps: Open the Demo-Account training sign-in screen.
Choose the practice Forgot password option.
Follow the instructor-provided reset exercise. Never paste passwords or reset codes into this chat.

guides.title: Demo-account locked sign-in

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
sections.text: Demo-Account login says account locked after repeated sign-in failures. This is a locked account, not a forgotten password exercise.
steps: Stop repeated sign-in attempts in the Demo-Account exercise.
Check the training screen for an account locked notice.
Give the notice text, without personal details, to your instructor or include it in a ticket draft.

guides.title: Demo-Mail web sign-in

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
sections.text: Demo-Mail email web sign-in is not working. The fictional email application cannot open the practice inbox.
steps: Open the fictional Demo-Mail training page.
Close extra Demo-Mail tabs and reload the training sign-in screen.
Try signing in once with the instructor-provided practice account.

guides.title: Demo-Inbox client sync

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
sections.text: Demo-Inbox email client is not syncing messages. The practice mailbox needs a manual synchronization check.
steps: Open the Demo-Inbox practice client.
Check that the training account is selected.
Choose Sync once and record any error without including message content.

guides.title: Demo-Writer installation on macOS

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
sections.text: Demo-Writer software installation on macOS will not start. Check the platform compatibility of the fictional training installer.
steps: Check that the Demo-Writer training package is labeled for macOS.
Close an existing Demo-Writer practice window.
Open the instructor-provided training installer. Stop and contact the instructor if administrator permission is required.

guides.title: Wi-Fi connects poorly or pages will not load — synthetic diagnostic guide

sections.heading: Initial diagnostic checks
sections.text: Wi-Fi network internet cannot connect keeps dropping disconnected connected without internet web pages spin forever slow wireless at home campus office cafe on any device. Original synthetic example guidance for the local demo; not official TechSpot instructions.
steps: Check whether the device shows a Wi-Fi connection or a disconnected indicator.
Check whether the same problem affects another app or website on this device.
If another device is available on the same network, compare whether it has the same problem. Note the result without sharing network credentials.

guides.title: Wi-Fi reconnect and error observation — synthetic diagnostic guide

sections.heading: Initial diagnostic checks
sections.text: Wireless Wi-Fi drops or connected without internet after comparing devices and apps. Alternative initial check for a known network on a phone laptop or desktop. Original synthetic example guidance for the local demo; not official TechSpot instructions.
steps: If you are on a call or transferring a file, wait until it is safe to interrupt the connection.
Turn Wi-Fi off and back on once, then select the network you normally use.
Note the exact connection message if it still fails. Do not share passwords or access codes.

guides.title: Printer produces no output or queue is stuck — synthetic diagnostic guide

sections.heading: Initial diagnostic checks
sections.text: The printer is not printing nothing comes out print job queue stuck printer offline on any computer. Original synthetic example guidance for the local demo; not official TechSpot instructions.
steps: Check the printer display for an error or an empty-paper indication without opening hardware covers.
Check that the print dialog names the printer you intended to use.
Look at the queue for your own print job and note whether it is paused, pending, or marked with an error.

guides.title: Check one print job after initial checks — synthetic diagnostic guide

sections.heading: Initial diagnostic checks
sections.text: Printing still fails after checking printer status and selected printer queue no output. Original synthetic example guidance for the local demo; not official TechSpot instructions.
steps: If your own print job is stuck, cancel only that job; leave other users’ jobs alone.
Try printing one small non-sensitive test document to the intended printer.
If it still fails, record the displayed error and the printer name for support.

guides.title: Email is not syncing or messages will not load — synthetic diagnostic guide

sections.heading: Initial diagnostic checks
sections.text: Email mailbox messages not syncing inbox blank mail not loading not receiving messages any mail app. Original synthetic example guidance for the local demo; not official TechSpot instructions.
steps: Check whether other websites or apps can connect on the same device.
Use the mail app’s normal Refresh or Sync control once.
Note whether the issue affects receiving, sending, or both, and record any displayed error without copying message contents.

guides.title: Sign-in or verification is failing — synthetic diagnostic guide

sections.heading: Initial diagnostic checks
sections.text: Cannot log in account sign in password rejected login loop verification MFA code not arriving access denied locked out. Original synthetic example guidance for the local demo; not official TechSpot instructions.
steps: Confirm the service name on the sign-in screen before entering any credentials.
Record the error wording without including account identifiers, passwords, verification codes or recovery links.
If the screen says the account is locked or requires an administrator, stop repeated attempts and contact that service’s support.

guides.title: An application freezes crashes or does not open — synthetic diagnostic guide

sections.heading: Initial diagnostic checks
sections.text: App application program software freezes crashes spinning not responding cannot open fails to launch slow app. Original synthetic example guidance for the local demo; not official TechSpot instructions.
steps: If the app is still usable, save any open work before making changes.
Check whether the problem affects only this app or other apps too.
Record the app name and any error wording, and whether the problem began after a recent change.

guides.title: Reopen an unresponsive application safely — synthetic diagnostic guide

sections.heading: Initial diagnostic checks
sections.text: Application still not responding after checking other apps and saving work. Reopen an app only when work is safe. Original synthetic example guidance for the local demo; not official TechSpot instructions.
steps: If there is unsaved work you cannot recover, stop here and ask support before closing the app.
Otherwise close the affected app normally and reopen it once.
Try a non-sensitive sample task. Note whether the same error returns.

guides.title: Device audio camera display or accessory issue — synthetic diagnostic guide

sections.heading: Initial diagnostic checks
sections.text: Device sound audio microphone camera webcam monitor display accessory bluetooth keyboard mouse not working no sound black screen not detected. Original synthetic example guidance for the local demo; not official TechSpot instructions.
steps: Note which device or accessory is affected and what you expected it to do.
Check whether the issue occurs in one app or in more than one app.
Record any visible error or status indication. Avoid opening hardware, changing security settings, or sharing personal content.

guides.title: Device is slow or freezes across apps — synthetic diagnostic guide

sections.heading: Initial diagnostic checks
sections.text: Computer laptop phone slow freezes hangs across all applications general device performance. Original synthetic example guidance for the local demo; not official TechSpot instructions.
steps: If possible, save any open work.
Note whether the slowdown affects one app or the entire device, and when it began.
If the device becomes unusually hot, smells burnt, or has a swollen battery, stop using it and seek qualified help.
